changes.oldText: Command palette: Adds a Search button to the header and the Ctrl+K (⌘K on macOS) shortcut, both of which open a palette for searching pages, page tabs, and setting items. The palette also offers quick actions such as switching between dark and light mode, changing the UI language, opening notifications, toggling the sidebar, and opening the manual for the current page. The button and the shortcut are available only while this feature is enabled. See Search for details.
